summary: This document extends BGP-LS to advertise BGP Peering Segments with their peering node information, so efficient Egress Peer Engineering policies can be computed using Segment Routing. A segment is an instruction, and a list of segment identifiers steers a packet.

eli5.summary: A network can choose which exit door to use to a neighbor. This document lets the doors be announced as segments so a planner can choose where traffic leaves.
